title: Radiesse calcium-based filler in Cairo
description: Discuss Radiesse in Cairo for selected facial contours, including the role of calcium-based filler, why the area matters and what recovery may involve.
answer: Radiesse is a calcium-based injectable used for selected contour or volume concerns. Adults considering facial filler can discuss it at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. The consultation looks at the area, tissue thickness and any previous filler, including whether another option would be easier to adjust later.
preparation: Tell us what was injected previously and where. This filler has different uses from lip fillers and cannot be dissolved like hyaluronic acid.
howPerformed: The team examines the area, agrees a contour goal and explains how the calcium-based product will be placed before proceeding.
followup: Recovery may include swelling, tenderness or bruising. Wait for swelling to settle before judging contour. Report lumps or worsening pain.
risks: Infection, uneven contour and vascular blockage are possible. Severe pain, unusual pallor or a change in vision require immediate medical attention.
